title: Clemency for other crypto and donor-linked figures
summary: Trump pardoned Ross Ulbricht (Jan 21, 2025), BitMEX's Hayes, Delo, Reed and Dwyer plus the operator HDR Global Trading (Mar 27, 2025), and Nikola founder Trevor Milton (Mar 28, 2025), who with his wife gave more than $1.8M to pro-Trump and allied committees in autumn 2024 (AP; breakdowns vary). The DOJ disbanded the NCET on Apr 7, 2025, and Binance paid lobbyists including Ches McDowell ($450K) and Teresa Goody Guillén (about $290K) for the CZ pardon. Roger Ver got a DOJ deferred prosecution deal (about $50M paid), not clemency. No evidence shows that any grant was bought.

sub_claims.finding: A full and unconditional pardon on Jan 21, 2025, fulfilling a May 2024 pledge to the Libertarian convention. Trump cited 'weaponization of government'. No donation or lobbying link was found.

sub_claims.statement: Trump pardoned the BitMEX co-founders and BitMEX itself.
sub_claims.finding: Signed Mar 27, 2025 for Arthur Hayes, Benjamin Delo, Samuel Reed, Gregory Dwyer and HDR Global Trading. All had pleaded guilty to Bank Secrecy Act violations. The individuals got probation; HDR was fined $100M in Jan 2025. No official justification. Whether the $100M fine was waived is unverified.

sub_claims.statement: Trump pardoned Nikola founder Trevor Milton, a donor.
sub_claims.finding: Confirmed Mar 28, 2025. Milton and his wife gave more than $1.8M per AP's reading of FEC records, less than a month before the election; another breakdown of the records has about $920K to the Trump 47 Committee in October 2024 and $750K to the RFK Jr.-linked MAHA Alliance in September, so the share that went directly to Trump committees is uncertain. Trump said Milton was targeted for supporting him. The pardon wiped out about $660-680M in sought restitution, and the SEC later dropped its civil case without explanation. Milton is not a crypto figure.

sub_claims.statement: Roger Ver received clemency via a settlement or deferred prosecution.
sub_claims.finding: A DOJ deferred prosecution agreement announced Oct 14, 2025, under which Ver paid about $48-50M in taxes, penalties and interest. This is not presidential clemency, and he was not pardoned. He paid Roger Stone $600K in 2025 to lobby on the exit tax; Stone denies lobbying the executive branch on his case.

sub_claims.statement: Lobbyists were paid for the CZ pardon.
sub_claims.finding: Per disclosures reported by Politico: Checkmate Government Relations (Ches McDowell, a friend of Trump Jr.) got $450K for about a month of 'executive relief' lobbying in late Sep 2025, and Teresa Goody Guillén (BakerHostetler, also counsel to WLF) got about $290K. McDowell told the WSJ he raised Zhao's case with Trump. Based on secondary coverage; Politico was not read directly.

sub_claims.statement: The DOJ disbanded its crypto enforcement unit (NCET).
sub_claims.finding: Deputy AG Todd Blanche's memo of Apr 7, 2025 disbanded the NCET effective immediately, saying the DOJ 'is not a digital assets regulator' and citing Trump's Jan 2025 executive order.

Donor-linked: Paul Walczak was pardoned Apr 23, 2025, weeks after his mother attended a $1M-per-head MAGA Inc. dinner; whether she paid is unclear. Crypto: Samourai's Keonne Rodriguez ('I'll look at it', Dec 2025) and SBF (applied Jun 2026, Trump says no) were not pardoned as of this search. No other crypto pardon found. Audit re-check (Nov 2026): no crypto-related pardon or commutation in 2026 was found; Rodriguez began a five-year sentence in late Dec 2025.

sub_claims.statement: Implied: donations or lobbying bought these grants.
sub_claims.finding: Money is documented in four places: the Milton donations, the Walczak dinner, the CZ lobbying and the Ver-Stone payment. No evidence of a quid pro quo was found, and those involved deny one.

corrections: Roger Ver got a DOJ deferred prosecution agreement and paid about $50M. He received no presidential clemency.
Trevor Milton's case was EV securities fraud, not a crypto case.
The BitMEX pardon covered four individuals (Hayes, Delo, Reed, Dwyer) and the entity HDR Global Trading.
The $450K CZ lobbying fee went to Ches McDowell's Checkmate. Goody Guillén's firm got about $290K.

Milton's 'more than $1.8M' is AP's total; one breakdown has ~$920K to the Trump 47 Committee (Oct 2024) and ~$750K to the RFK Jr.-linked MAHA Alliance (Sept 2024), so not all of it went to Trump committees in October.
denials_and_context: The White House frames these pardons as correcting Biden DOJ 'weaponization'. Trump said Milton was prosecuted for supporting him.
No official justification was found for the BitMEX pardons. The individuals had faced only probation.
Roger Stone denies lobbying the executive branch on Ver's case. Ches McDowell says Trump Jr. did not help. Goody Guillén says CZ was 'pardoned for justice'.
The NCET disbandment was a policy memo, not clemency. Fraud prosecutions continued, for example Tornado Cash's Roman Storm in 2025.
Many mainstream outlets were not read directly. Politico, NYT and WSJ details come from secondary coverage.
Zhao claims in his April 2026 memoir that US crypto rivals 'paid millions in lobbying fees to block the pardon'; this is his assertion, not an established finding.
